title: Exported vs Unexported Identifiers
focus: uppercase/lowercase naming, visibility rules, API design
rules: IsExported returns true for uppercase-starting names

flashcards.front: How do you make a Go identifier exported (public)?
flashcards.back: Start with an uppercase letter. That's it — Go's visibility is purely based on the first character.

flashcards.front: Can unexported identifiers be accessed from other packages?
flashcards.back: No. Only exported identifiers (uppercase first letter) are visible to other packages.

flashcards.front: What is the convention for unexported helper functions?
flashcards.back: Use lowercase, often with a leading underscore or just lowercase. Keep them short and descriptive.

flashcards.front: Should types be exported or unexported?
flashcards.back: Export types that form your API surface. Keep implementation details unexported.
